title: Classification of 2D Fermionic Systems with a $\mathbb Z_2$ Flavor Symmetry
summary: We classify superfusion categories describing two-dimensional fermionic systems equipped with the universal fermion-parity symmetry, implemented by a topological defect line (TDL) $Z$, and an additional $\mathbb{Z}_2$ flavor symmetry generated by a $W$ TDL. Depending on whether $W$ is m-type or q-type, its fusion rules lead to three distinct classes, and solving the super-pentagon equations yields 16 consistent superfusion categories. These are labeled by invariants $(ν_W,ν_Z,ν_{WZ})$, which determine the $\mathbb{Z}_8$ anomaly classes of the symmetries generated by $W$, $Z$, and $WZ$. We…
